evidence: Major changes to .github/workflows/ci.yml and ci/test/* scripts replacing cross-compilation with a native VM CI job.
rationale: Adds a native FreeBSD CI job running the full test suite in a VM to catch platform-specific regressions before merge instead of relying on nightly runs. As reviewer fanquake noted, running tests reliably in Core CI is preferable to noisy external nightly failures, though FreeBSD is not a tier-1 release target.
